title: USMMA - Knovel 35/AI Enhanced e-book database subscription
agency_path: TRANSPORTATION, DEPARTMENT OF.MARITIME ADMINISTRATION.6923G2 DOT  MARITIME ADMINISTRATION
detail_text: Knovel 35/AI Enhanced ebook annual subscription (all web-based, no software required); for the base period of 06/01/2026 - 05/31/2027 + 4 option years. The Knovel 35/AI Enhanced e-book database collection is a unique collection of specialized engineering and math and science e-books. Also includes modules on Fire Protection engineering and emergency response, Industrial engineering and operations management, Manufacturing engineering, Welding engineering and materials joining, Optics and photonics, and Safety and industrial hygiene, which directly support the USMMA Marine Engineering curriculum. Contractor to submit 1-2 page document for quote. Quote should list base year pricing and each option year. Quotation deadlines are due by May 07, 2026 at 2:30PM via electronic mail (e-mail). This requirement is a total set-aside for small business concerns. This presolicitation incorporates provisions and clauses by reference. The full text of provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at www.acquisition.gov. All responsible small business sources may submit a response which, if timely received, will be considered by the agency. SAM REGISTRATION All interested parties must have an active registration with the federal SAM system https://Sam.gov/ to receive an award. The provision at 52.212-1, Instructions to Offerors-Commercial, applies to this presolicitation. The provision at 52.212-4, Terms and Conditions–Commercial Products and Commercial Services. A copy of the provision may be attained from https://www.acquisition.gov/far-overhaul/.
